title: Stamp mission_id onto task payloads in WorkflowEngine
description: Goal (a) — task provenance. In src/dispatcher/WorkflowEngine.mag, mirror the existing workflow-payload stamp at lines 145-147 at BOTH task-creation sites: (1) role taskPayload build site (~482-536; `params` is in scope): (params at: 'mission' ifAbsent: [nil]) notNil ifTrue: [taskPayload at: 'mission_id' put: (params at: 'mission')]. (2) archivist site dispatchArchivist: (~792-803): the workflow tuple is re-read at 783-787, so read wfPayload at: 'mission_id' ifAbsent: [nil] and stamp when present. Do NOT stamp dispatchStrategist: (~811) — it is scope-level with no workflow/params context. Backward compat: absence of mission_id must never error (all readers already use at:'mission_id' ifAbsent:[nil]). Ganso's ix_mission virtual column (GansoStore.mag:52-68) is category-agnostic, so stamped tasks are index-queryable with zero schema work. Acceptance: run a mission-launched workflow, inspect a created task tuple — payload.mission_id present and equals the mission id; tasks enumerable by mission_id; non-mission workflows produce unstamped tasks; unit test in test/ covering both sites plus the strategist-excluded case. Update CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] in the same commit. Maggie gotchas: rm the binary before rebuild; temp vars at top.

title: Mission-scoped worktree reclamation in pp mission nuke
description: Goal (b) — worktree reclamation, probe-free. DO NOT call Repo>>cmdWorktreeClean: wholesale: its status probe GET /api/v1/workflow/status/<id> (Repo.mag:347) hits a route that does not exist in Server.mag, so a live server returns empty ⇒ shouldRemove:=true for EVERY worktree including other missions' live ones (fail-dangerous). Instead: (1) Add MissionCLI>>allWorkflowsForMission: — clone runningWorkflowsForMission: (MissionCLI.mag:478-507) but drop the status='running' filter, keeping the payload.mission_id / params.mission ownership test (terminal pipelines are exactly the orphan-leavers). (2) Add Repo>>cleanWorktreesForInstances:dryRun: that positively selects ~/.pp/worktrees/<instanceId> dirs whose name is IN the mission's instance-id set (membership IS the removal predicate — no probe), reusing only the removal half of cleanWorktreeTask: (Repo.mag:380-398: git worktree remove || rm -rf per subdir, then rm -rf task dir); use the shellRun-to-tmpfile pattern, NOT Shell capture:. Leave cleanWorktreeTask:/cmdWorktreeClean: semantics untouched — test_worktree_clean.mag WC1-WC4 depend on them. (3) Wire into MissionCLI>>cmdNuke: (MissionCLI.mag:398-476) after workflow cancellation; extend the dry-run listing to enumerate tasks (scan category 'task' filtering payload.mission_id, mirroring workitemsForMission: at 530-554) and worktree dirs. Fail-safe: missing id list / missing worktree signal ⇒ KEEP. HAZARD: the scope ivar/block-shadow trap is live in MissionCLI.mag (:410-413, :536-539) — use msnScope/sc parameter names in all new methods. Acceptance: nuke --confirm removes the mission's worktree dirs; other missions'/workflows' worktrees untouched; dry-run enumerates tasks + worktrees and changes nothing; WC1-WC4 still pass; new tests with real temp dirs per the WCTest harness convention. Update CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] in the same commit.

title: Mission-scoped unmerged-branch reclamation in pp mission nuke
description: Goal (c) — branch reclamation. MUST run after the worktree story: impl/<instanceId> is checked out inside its worktree and git refuses branch -D on checked-out branches (functional dependency, not just same-file serialization; also both stories edit cmdNuke:). DO NOT reuse Repo>>cmdCleanBranches: as-is: default -d skips unmerged branches (Repo.mag:474) and --all -D destroys ALL unmerged branches repo-wide (Repo.mag:484). Instead add Repo>>cleanBranchesForInstances:in:dryRun: that (1) builds candidate names impl/<id> + feature/<id> from the mission's instance-id set (cross-check each instance's durable 'worktree' signal payload: branch/feature_branch/repo_path), DEDUPING shared feature/<parentId> branches used by wave children; (2) applies a NAME-BASED guard — delete feature/<id> only when <id> ∈ mission instance-id set, never 'whatever feature_branch says' (parent_branch can be 'main' for hotfix templates; see DiscardWorktreeAction.mag:57); (3) deletes via GitOps deleteBranchForce:in: (GitOps.mag:85, git branch -D) — NOT deleteBranch: (-d), which fails warn-only on unmerged branches; (4) SKIPS branches already merged to main (git branch --merged main per Repo.mag:444 or GitOps commitsAheadOf:on:in: GitOps.mag:106) — merged branches are untouched per criterion 3; (5) uses GitOps branchExists:in: (GitOps.mag:97) for the dry-run listing. Wire into MissionCLI>>cmdNuke: AFTER the worktree-removal step and after all cancels complete (cancel already precedes, MissionCLI.mag:456-460); extend dry-run listing with branches. Fail-safe: ambiguity ⇒ KEEP. Use msnScope/sc names (ivar shadow trap). Acceptance: nuke --confirm deletes the mission's unmerged impl/*+feature/* branches; merged branches and other missions' branches untouched; dry-run lists branches and changes nothing; tests cover force-delete of unmerged, merged-skip, shared-feature dedupe, and name-guard. Update CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] in the same commit.

title: End-to-end nuke safety test: partially-merged mission fixture + regression sweep
description: Criterion 5 + 6 safety net, budgeted explicitly (the expensive test). Build a fixture: temp git repo + mission whose work PARTIALLY merged to main (one instance's feature branch merged, another left unmerged with a live worktree dir), plus a decoy second mission with its own worktree + branches. Then: (1) dry-run `pp mission nuke <id>` — assert output enumerates workflows, work-items, tasks, worktrees, branches AND filesystem/git state is byte-identical after (git rev-parse main + branch list + dir listing before/after). (2) `nuke --confirm` — assert: git log main unchanged and merged content intact (criterion 5); the mission's unmerged branches and worktrees gone; the decoy mission's worktree/branches and the merged branch untouched; pre-stamp legacy tasks (no mission_id) tolerated and NOT enumerated. (3) Full regression: mag test green including test/cli/test_worktree_clean.mag WC1-WC4 unchanged and test_mission_cli.mag MS1-MS8. Follow the WCTest harness convention (real temp dirs, per-task rescue assertions); remember mag test dirs are non-recursive (list explicitly) and rm the binary before rebuild. Add new test file(s) under test/cli/. Update CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] only if user-visible behavior changed (likely test-only — omit changelog if so).
